claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace gives him a continuous in-geofence dwell of only 230 seconds — first qualifying fix 07:15:50, last 07:19:40, 24 qualifying fixes in one unbroken run — against the 300 second minimum that POL-NS-01 sets for a STANDARD pickup zone and that POL-NS-06 repeats. The shortfall is 70 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is simply not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered anything.

POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive, and this trip breaks it twice. Limb (c): the dwell runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (07:15:50), not from the driver's 07:15:52 'arrived' tap, and on that basis it reached only 230 of the required 300 seconds — the clock never ran out. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 07:19:50, sixty seconds BEFORE the required 300 seconds would have elapsed at 07:20:50. The no-show charge therefore fails on the dwell limb and on the termination-timing limb independently, and neither failure is cured by the reason code the driver selected.

The rider's own track corroborates her account that she was standing at the vehicle. Her device is within 11.3 m of the pickup pin at its furthest, stationary throughout (its only recorded speed is 0.0 kph) across all 28 of her fixes, continuously from 07:15:40 to 07:19:43 — the whole of the driver's dwell and past his cancellation. That is far inside the 100 m rider presence radius POL-NS-04 sets for a STANDARD zone, and it sits inside the driver's own 50 m arrival radius at the same moments his trace does. On the telemetry, the 'no-show' describes the driver's early departure, not the rider's absence.

Honest concession on one point: POL-NS-04 is not available to me on this record. Limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating chat message, and the chat log holds zero messages for this trip (message_count 0), so my client's account of showing the booking on her phone was given at the kerb and never entered the app. Limb (b) correspondingly cannot be run against a driver who had nothing to answer. I do not press POL-NS-04; the refund rests on the dwell shortfall, which needs no chat log at all.

The driver cannot pad the clock. POL-NS-06 limb (i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic advisory of an admissible type covers the pickup road — and EV-ADVIS-00617-01 is MISSING, carrying issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at weight 0.0. Its absence is itself the argument: no advisory covers this road in this window, so limb (i) is unavailable here, and in any event the trace shows run_count 1 with max_excursion_m null — a single interval, with no second interval for limb (i) to add. The 70 second shortfall stands undiminished.

No compensation is payable to this driver. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; the dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the rider does not fund the driver's departure. The anti-farming figures are not even in play on these numbers: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 110 completed trips in the same 30 days, nowhere near the combined 4-or-more and 0.08-rate test, and no other profile field bears on this question.

The money is live and its size is not in dispute: the fare breakdown carries a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, with base, distance, time, waiting, platform and surge components all at zero. A full refund under POL-NS-06 returns exactly the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line to the rider and nothing further, which is the outcome amount_sgd should carry on this rider-filed dispute.

claims.text: The driver's own trace puts him at the pin, not merely near it: EV-GPS-00617 records 24 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, each one passing the 25 m reported-accuracy filter, with the closest fix 6.91 m from the pin and the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 07:15:50 — two seconds before the trip record's 'arrived' event at 07:15:52. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied on the platform's own telemetry, and any suggestion that the driver never turned up is contradicted by the record.

The arrival marker is true on every POL-NS-05 test: at the 07:15:52 arrival event the driver is 6.91 m from the pickup pin — nowhere near the 300 m threshold — and his trace peaks at 13.0 km/h against the 15.0 km/h motion threshold, so he was stationary, not still in motion on a road when he marked arrival. The waiting clock was not falsely started and no false-arrival finding or referral under POL-NS-05(ii) attaches to this trip.

Limb (d) is satisfied on the face of the trip record: no boarding event occurred and the driver terminated the trip at 07:19:50 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) expressly recognises. This is not a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission, the code the clause disqualifies, and the recorded code is the one limb (d) reads.

The rider gains no exoneration under POL-NS-04, because limb (a) cannot be met on this record: EV-CHAT-00617 holds zero messages and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so there is no locating or coordinating message from the rider for the driver to have ignored, and no 120-second silence interval to measure. The disputed conversation — the last four digits and the phone screen — appears in no artifact at all, and on that point the case is word against word.

The record shows no no-show harvesting by the driver, and only the two profile fields POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-01 permit may be used to say so: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 110, a rate of about 0.9 percent. Neither limb of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is met (4 or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08), so no adverse profile inference and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation can rest on the driver's history.

I do not and cannot assert accumulation of dwell under POL-NS-06(i): the only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00617-01, is MISSING — no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — and limb (i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present, populated and of an admissible type. EV-GPS-00617 also shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for limb (i) to add to the first even if an advisory existed; asserting the limb against a missing artifact is precisely what the policy forecloses rather than a route to help the driver.

The dwell is where this case goes against the driver and I do not dispute the arithmetic: the longest continuous in-geofence run is 230 seconds, from 07:15:50 to 07:19:40, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum — a 70-second shortfall — so POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails, the driver cannot sustain the charge on this trip, and because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full the 80 percent compensation POL-NS-07 provides (which would have been SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 line) is not payable. I ask only that the ruling record what the same trace does establish for the driver: he arrived at the pin, held position for nearly four minutes, marked arrival truthfully and coded the termination honestly.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00617 is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is payable to the driver.

Why the fee does not stand. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold, and limb (c) fails. Measure the dwell as the clause directs - from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' tap. On EV-GPS-00617 that first qualifying fix is at 07:15:50 (the trace carries 24 qualifying fixes, each inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius with reported accuracy of 25 m or better), and the single continuous in-geofence run ends at 07:19:40. That is 230 seconds against the 300-second minimum the fee schedule sets for a STANDARD pickup - a 70-second shortfall. The driver's own advocate accepts this figure, as does the rider's; the platform computed it and it is not in dispute. POL-NS-06 then applies directly: a dwell shorter than the minimum means the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered anything. POL-NS-01 itself says that where any limb fails, the refund is decided under POL-NS-06, and that is the route taken here. The shortfall is not affected by the empty chat log (EV-CHAT-00617 holds no messages, so POL-NS-04 is unavailable to the rider - no coordinating message was sent for the driver to answer, and the rider correctly does not press it) and it is not affected by the conversation about the last four digits, which appears in no artifact and is word against word; that account, like the driver's counterparty statement that he cancelled because the app showed different digits, records a reason for the cancellation but does not cure the dwell. The trip record does code the termination RIDER_NO_SHOW and shows no boarding event, so limb (d) is met on its face, but limb (c) fails independently and that is fatal to the charge.

Why no driver compensation. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the cancellation fee (SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 line) only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06 displaces it, so no compensation arises. I have also checked the anti-farming limb: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against completed_trips_30d of 110 (about 0.9 percent), far from the combined 4-or-more and above-0.08 test, so no adverse inference and no escalation arises on the driver's history.

On the points raised for the driver. I accept that he reached the pickup pin: the first qualifying fix at 07:15:50 sits two seconds before his 07:15:52 arrival marker, and his closest fix is 6.91 m from the pin. I accept that the arrival marker is true on every POL-NS-05 test - 6.91 m against the 300 m threshold, and a trace peaking at 13.0 km/h against the 15.0 km/h motion threshold - so no false-arrival finding and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral attaches to this trip. Those findings are recorded, but they establish only that he arrived; they cannot supply the remaining 70 seconds of the required wait. The dwell cannot be padded under POL-NS-06(i) either: the only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00617-01, is MISSING (no payload, weight 0.0), and the trace shows a single in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to sum.

The refund returns exactly the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.00 carried in EV-FARE-00617 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, all other fare components zero) and nothing further. Confidence is high: the deciding dwell figure rests on EV-GPS-00617 at weight 1.0 with 100 percent coverage and no sampling gaps, and the trip record timestamps agree with it to within two seconds, so no integrity limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged and no escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 fires.

On the points raised for the driver. I accept that he reached the pickup pin: the first qualifying fix at 07:15:50 sits two seconds before his 07:15:52 arrival marker, and his closest fix is 6.91 m from the pin. I accept that the arrival marker is true on every POL-NS-05 test - 6.91 m against the 300 m threshold, and a trace peaking at 13.0 km/h against the 15.0 km/h motion threshold - so no false-arrival finding and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral attaches to this trip. Those findings are recorded, but they establish only that he arrived; they cannot supply the remaining 70 seconds of the required wait. The dwell cannot be padded under POL-NS-06(i) either: the only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00617-01, is MISSING (no payload, weight 0.0), and the trace shows a single in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to sum.

The refund returns exactly the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.00 carried in EV-FARE-00617 (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, all other fare components zero) and nothing further. Confidence is high: the deciding dwell figure rests on EV-GPS-00617 at weight 1.0 with 100 percent coverage and no sampling gaps, and the trip record timestamps agree with it to within two seconds, so no integrity limb of POL-NS-08 is engaged and no escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 fires."},"discarded_claims":[]}

ruling.explanation: Both parties actually agree on the decisive measurement, and the platform's own telemetry settles it. On the question the driver argued first: he DID arrive. His GPS trace (EV-GPS-00617) places him 6.91 m from the pickup pin, with 24 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied, and I record that. But the no-show fee needs all four limbs of POL-NS-01, and limb (c) fails. The clause measures the hold from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 07:15:50, not from the driver's 07:15:52 'arrived' tap. His longest continuous in-geofence run was 230 seconds, ending when he cancelled at 07:19:50 — 70 seconds short of the 300-second STANDARD minimum set by fee_schedule and repeated in POL-NS-06. Limb (d) also fails on its own terms: although RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three codes the clause recognises, the clause requires termination at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, and 07:19:50 is 60 seconds before the 300 seconds would have elapsed at 07:20:50. Either failure defeats the charge; the reason code the driver honestly selected does not cure the missing time. Under POL-NS-06 the shortfall makes the cancellation fee not chargeable and refunds it in full, whether or not the rider was present — this is strict liability, not a finding of dishonesty against the driver. The POL-NS-06(i) accumulation route is unavailable in any event: the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00617-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), and the trace shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1, no excursion). Because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, the 80 percent driver compensation under POL-NS-07 (which would have been SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 line) is not payable; the anti-farming check is not reached and does not trip on these figures. The arrival marker itself was genuine — 6.91 m from the pin, trace peaking at 13.0 km/h against the 15 km/h motion threshold — so no false-arrival finding or POL-NS-05(ii) referral attaches to this trip. The rider's presence track (within 11.3 m of the pin across all 28 fixes, 07:15:40 to 07:19:43) corroborates her account but is not needed for the outcome, and POL-NS-04 is not available to her because EV-CHAT-00617 holds zero messages, so the last-four-digits exchange at the kerb is word against word and I draw nothing from it either way. Money: the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00617) carries a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00, total_charged SGD 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, against the STANDARD zone-class fee of SGD 4.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00. A full refund returns that SGD 4.00 line to the rider and nothing further. No evidence artifact meets any of the POL-NS-08(a)-(d) impairment limbs, no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires, and the ruling rests on artifacts at weight 1.0.

ledger.claim: The driver's own GPS trace gives him a continuous in-geofence dwell of only 230 seconds — first qualifying fix 07:15:50, last 07:19:40, 24 qualifying fixes in one unbroken run — against the 300 second minimum that POL-NS-01 sets for a STANDARD pickup zone and that POL-NS-06 repeats. The shortfall is 70 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is simply not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered anything.

POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive, and this trip breaks it twice. Limb (c): the dwell runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (07:15:50), not from the driver's 07:15:52 'arrived' tap, and on that basis it reached only 230 of the required 300 seconds — the clock never ran out. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 07:19:50, sixty seconds BEFORE the required 300 seconds would have elapsed at 07:20:50. The no-show charge therefore fails on the dwell limb and on the termination-timing limb independently, and neither failure is cured by the reason code the driver selected.

The rider's own track corroborates her account that she was standing at the vehicle. Her device is within 11.3 m of the pickup pin at its furthest, stationary throughout (its only recorded speed is 0.0 kph) across all 28 of her fixes, continuously from 07:15:40 to 07:19:43 — the whole of the driver's dwell and past his cancellation. That is far inside the 100 m rider presence radius POL-NS-04 sets for a STANDARD zone, and it sits inside the driver's own 50 m arrival radius at the same moments his trace does. On the telemetry, the 'no-show' describes the driver's early departure, not the rider's absence.

Honest concession on one point: POL-NS-04 is not available to me on this record. Limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating chat message, and the chat log holds zero messages for this trip (message_count 0), so my client's account of showing the booking on her phone was given at the kerb and never entered the app. Limb (b) correspondingly cannot be run against a driver who had nothing to answer. I do not press POL-NS-04; the refund rests on the dwell shortfall, which needs no chat log at all.

The driver cannot pad the clock. POL-NS-06 limb (i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a present and populated traffic advisory of an admissible type covers the pickup road — and EV-ADVIS-00617-01 is MISSING, carrying issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at weight 0.0. Its absence is itself the argument: no advisory covers this road in this window, so limb (i) is unavailable here, and in any event the trace shows run_count 1 with max_excursion_m null — a single interval, with no second interval for limb (i) to add. The 70 second shortfall stands undiminished.

No compensation is payable to this driver. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; the dwell shortfall under POL-NS-06 displaces it, so the rider does not fund the driver's departure. The anti-farming figures are not even in play on these numbers: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 110 completed trips in the same 30 days, nowhere near the combined 4-or-more and 0.08-rate test, and no other profile field bears on this question.

The money is live and its size is not in dispute: the fare breakdown carries a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, with base, distance, time, waiting, platform and surge components all at zero. A full refund under POL-NS-06 returns exactly the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line to the rider and nothing further, which is the outcome amount_sgd should carry on this rider-filed dispute.

The driver's own trace puts him at the pin, not merely near it: EV-GPS-00617 records 24 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, each one passing the 25 m reported-accuracy filter, with the closest fix 6.91 m from the pin and the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 07:15:50 — two seconds before the trip record's 'arrived' event at 07:15:52. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied on the platform's own telemetry, and any suggestion that the driver never turned up is contradicted by the record.

The arrival marker is true on every POL-NS-05 test: at the 07:15:52 arrival event the driver is 6.91 m from the pickup pin — nowhere near the 300 m threshold — and his trace peaks at 13.0 km/h against the 15.0 km/h motion threshold, so he was stationary, not still in motion on a road when he marked arrival. The waiting clock was not falsely started and no false-arrival finding or referral under POL-NS-05(ii) attaches to this trip.

Limb (d) is satisfied on the face of the trip record: no boarding event occurred and the driver terminated the trip at 07:19:50 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) expressly recognises. This is not a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission, the code the clause disqualifies, and the recorded code is the one limb (d) reads.

The rider gains no exoneration under POL-NS-04, because limb (a) cannot be met on this record: EV-CHAT-00617 holds zero messages and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so there is no locating or coordinating message from the rider for the driver to have ignored, and no 120-second silence interval to measure. The disputed conversation — the last four digits and the phone screen — appears in no artifact at all, and on that point the case is word against word.

The record shows no no-show harvesting by the driver, and only the two profile fields POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-01 permit may be used to say so: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 110, a rate of about 0.9 percent. Neither limb of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is met (4 or more terminations AND a rate above 0.08), so no adverse profile inference and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation can rest on the driver's history.

I do not and cannot assert accumulation of dwell under POL-NS-06(i): the only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00617-01, is MISSING — no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — and limb (i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present, populated and of an admissible type. EV-GPS-00617 also shows a single in-geofence interval (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for limb (i) to add to the first even if an advisory existed; asserting the limb against a missing artifact is precisely what the policy forecloses rather than a route to help the driver.

The dwell is where this case goes against the driver and I do not dispute the arithmetic: the longest continuous in-geofence run is 230 seconds, from 07:15:50 to 07:19:40, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum — a 70-second shortfall — so POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails, the driver cannot sustain the charge on this trip, and because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full the 80 percent compensation POL-NS-07 provides (which would have been SGD 3.20 of the SGD 4.00 line) is not payable. I ask only that the ruling record what the same trace does establish for the driver: he arrived at the pin, held position for nearly four minutes, marked arrival truthfully and coded the termination honestly.
